# API routes

<!-- GENERATED by production/scripts/ops/gen-api-doc.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- After adding, removing or changing a route: cd production && node scripts/ops/gen-api-doc.mjs -->

**309 route files** under `production/src/app` (Next.js route handlers), in 62 groups.
Paths: `[id]` is shown as `:id`, `[...path]` as `:path*`; route groups like `(auth)` are dropped.

**Who may call** is a hint read from each route's own code, not a guarantee:

- `session` — a signed-in user (`withRoute()` or `auth.getUser()`); `session + role` — also checks the user's role or permission.
- `cron secret` — `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>` (Cloud Scheduler); see `src/app/api/cron/_lib/cron-auth.ts`.
- `webhook signature` — an HMAC / provider signature check; `inbound secret` — a shared ingest secret.
- `API key` — a tenant API key (`/api/v1`, `src/lib/api-keys`); `DMS panel key` — called by the DMS app.
- `signed token` — a one-time or signed link token; `agent token` — the internal AI agent queue token.
- `platform admin` — the platform operator only; `JWT (data gateway)` — the `/api/sb` gateway reads the caller from its JWT.
- `public` — under `/api/public`, no check found (anonymous by design); `sign-in flow` — a sign-in/auth route with no other check found;
  `dev only` — under `/api/dev` (local and test only).
- `?` — nothing recognisable found; read the route before trusting it.

The real guards are the ratchet tests `src/app/api/admin-client-ratchet.test.ts` (service-role routes) and
`src/app/api/role-gate-ratchet.test.ts` (mutating routes need a role gate).
